about.title: Hereva
about.intro: {project} be matamatana platform peer-to-peer file hahebou, modern decentralized technology dekenai e karaia. Ia hahebou interface auka be raka decentralized architecture, e gwau file hahebou be namo bona namba server tamona lasi. Inai project be open source, {license} dekenai e tore.

decentralized.title: Decentralized network ibounai
decentralized.description: Server tamona lasi, tamona kavakavana dika diba lasi. Taudia ese davaria bona abia diho hereva direct ta ta amo, index tamona, tracker eiava database lasi.

accessControl.title: Maino keko hereva
accessControl.description: Tau ibounai ese sibona network e karaia diba sibona taravatu danu, davana lasi. Network ibounai dekenai, taudia roledia: biaguna, administrator, hahedinarai, moderator, bona murimuri tau. Oi maino keko hereva daika ese hahedinarai, moderate bona abia diho hereva e karaia diba.

ui.title: Namo herea interface
ui.description: Goeva bona haraga media center interface, desktop, televise bona mobile platforms dekenai e karaia. Auka raka keyboard, mouse, gamepad eiava remote control dekenai. Diba bada taudia ese software headless data server e karaia diba command-line interface dekenai.

dataFormat.title: Tau e duahia diba data format
dataFormat.description: LISH data format be JSON dekenai e karaia, e karaia auka, duahia bona dibaia. Hahebou hereva e gwau bona kemegumegu metadata, tau ibounai ese auka itadiba.

security.title: Hunia bona namo
security.description: Peer-to-peer hereva ibounai be encrypted, e gwau hereva be hunia transit dekenai. Taudia ese VPN murimurinai e hunia diba. {project} ese oiemu hunia e raraia design dekenai.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software be Windows, Linux bona macOS dekenai. Platform oi ura herea dekenai gaukara.

download.title: Abia diho
download.description: {project} oiemu platform abia. Abia diho ibounai be davana lasi bona open source.
